title: Chick Webb's band at the Savoy
summary: Wilson remembers listening to Webb's simple but swinging band, powered by Webb and John Kirby, while playing opposite it with Willie Bryant.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Chick Webb? Oh, yes. When I was with Willy Bryant's band and playing opposite Chick in the Savoy, every set I'd just listen to that Chick Webb band. And the band played so simple but it sounded so good. And part of it was that rhythm section, with Chick on those drums and John Kirby on the bass. That band swung so good that anybody
had to play one note, anything in the place sounded good.
That was a very special band, that Chick Webb band.
